title: Why SQL still matters
body_md:
## Why SQL still matters

Lesson 1 of 8 in *SQL for Analysts*. Query relational data with confidence, from simple filters to window functions.

Lesson 3 of 9 in *Design Systems in Practice*. Build and run a design system that teams actually adopt: tokens, components, docs and governance.

### In this lesson

- The core ideas behind components and variants
- How this lesson connects to the rest of Design Systems in Practice
- A short exercise to try on your own work

### Key ideas

Start with the video, then read the notes below. The examples build on the previous lesson.

Keep a note of one situation from your own work where **components and variants** applies. You will use it in the exercise.

### Exercise

Spend ten minutes applying the ideas to your own example. Write down what you tried and what you would change next time.
